local-screenshot.description: Only the bundled screenshot dialog can capture, preview, copy or request a native PNG save dialog. No remote page access.

local-shell.description: Only bundled shell/settings webviews can invoke preview controls. The remote Vibe webview and authentication pages get no native capabilities.

local-updates.description: Only the bundled local update window can download a validated offered artifact or open its verified file. No arbitrary URLs or paths.

local-workspace.description: Alleen het meegeleverde lokale gespreksvenster. Geen externe webpagina krijgt toegang.

standalone.description: Alleen de gebundelde lokale hoofdinterface. Mistral-aanmeldvensters hebben geen native bestandsrechten.
